acceptance_criteria: The displayed READY_FOR_CONFIRMATION state and actual confirmation operation share the existing deterministic prerequisites that can be evaluated before acceptance; no authoritative contract or ReportDesign is created before explicit confirmation.

Confirmation is bound to the exact visible interpretation and material request, schema and applicable configuration context, and tampered, incomplete, stale or superseded confirmation provenance fails closed.
Late analysis responses cannot replace a newer legitimate session, and changed request, schema or interpretation invalidates stale readiness without erasing retained provenance.
Repeated answer, correction and confirmation actions are idempotently rejected or ignored so one human decision cannot create duplicate contracts or launch duplicate generation.
Provider or technical failures preserve recoverable request, raw-answer and analysis context and remain distinct from business ambiguity, unsupported intent and human-review states.

A legitimate material downstream design conflict may return to analysis and fresh acceptance while retaining the previous accepted contract as history; structural technical correction does not become invented business ambiguity.
Existing question, round, answer, retry, cost and time limits retain their configured aggregate effect; the historical shared-budget observation is not represented as a reproduced root cause.
Four unrelated synthetic domains and renamed input fields exercise the same production lifecycle with no scenario, KPI, table, column, fixture or filename branching in production code.
Existing ConfirmedRequirementContract versions remain compatible and APBRA-143/APBRA-144 semantic and confirmation boundaries plus downstream safety regressions remain strict.
Unavailable BI-expert service is described honestly; no queue, takeover, collaboration, release, runtime or deployment success is fabricated.

The broader APBRA-147 recovery and expert roadmap plus completion of APBRA-31, APBRA-33, APBRA-34, APBRA-103 and APBRA-150 remain outside this bounded acceptance; APBRA-149 through APBRA-158 remain unselected.
